chapters.title: Breakfast
chapters.text: At 8:10 in the morning, you sat at the wooden dining table with a plate of scrambled eggs, tomatoes, toast, and a mug. You rested your chin on your hand while looking forward.

chapters.title: Preparing Vegetables
chapters.text: At 11:00, you and a younger woman prepared vegetables together in the kitchen. You cut carrots on a wooden board while she placed green leafy vegetables into a bowl.
caregiver_facts: The caregiver and the older woman prepared vegetables together.

chapters.title: Reading a Book
chapters.text: At 2:20 in the afternoon, you sat in an armchair by the window and read a book. A mug rested on the small wooden table next to you.

chapters.title: Visit with Anna
chapters.text: At 4:10, your daughter Anna came to visit. You and Anna looked through an open photo album together while sitting on the couch.
caregiver_facts: The visitor was her daughter Anna.
Anna and the older woman looked through a photo album together.

chapters.title: Dinner
chapters.text: At 6:30 in the evening, you sat at the wooden dining table in the dining room. A plate with salmon, broccoli, carrots, and grains, alongside a ceramic mug, was in front of you.
